source='''def components(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]; seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.add((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; comps=components(grid)
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
        if h<3 or w<3 or len(cells)!=h+w-1: continue
        elbow=None
        for er in (r0,r1):
            for ec in (c0,c1):
                if (er,ec) in cells and all((er,x) in cells for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((y,ec) in cells for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                    elbow=(er,ec); break
            if elbow: break
        if not elbow: continue
        er,ec=elbow
        # The open quadrant opposite the two arms.
        down = er==r0
        right = ec==c0
        candidates=[]
        for other,obj in comps:
            if obj is cells or len(obj)<3: continue
            cr=sum(r for r,c in obj)/len(obj); cc=sum(c for r,c in obj)/len(obj)
            if (cr>er if down else cr<er) and (cc>ec if right else cc<ec):
                candidates.append(obj)
        if candidates:
            target=max(candidates,key=len)
            for r,c in target: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
